# Pi Mobile — source map for code agents

Read AGENTS.md and the active goal loop-develop/current-todo/001-todo.md before changing code. This repository is a mobile window onto the SAME running Pi in Orca; tests must not reload/interrupt it or send paid prompts. The 0.6.005 UI hotfix is completed history. Billy explicitly authorized release0.6.006 and then APK delivery to Parilka228 on7 October2026; versionCode13, previous certificate/dependencies unchanged. Release evidence/limits: docs/release-0.6.006.md. Billy requested a coherent whole-product visual redesign on 7 October based on assistant-ui/Mobbin, not another component list; current local changes/evidence are in docs/ui-redesign-20261007.md. The redesign retained signature/dependencies; release metadata is now0.6.006/versionCode13. It uses borderless neutral surfaces, bare collapsible tools, full-canvas reading behind floating header/composer gradients, and a full-width writing row over four controls. Only confirmed live active agents/workflows appear in the dock; workflow detail is actual phases → agents with tools/tokens/time. Queue above input is the app's busy Follow Up receipt projection, not a global scheduler: ACK does not consume, new canonical echoes consume FIFO, restore is Last known and never replays. Catalog uses plain compact rows, a muted workspace label distinct from16sp regular chat titles, and compact unified Usage with an official black/white OpenAI SVG/vector (docs/ui-assets/openai). Typography rationale/source limitations: docs/ui-typography-20261007.md. Header shows the actual host with connection icon/spinner LEFT and8dp gap, separate equal48dp refresh/settings actions at4dp gap. Never show an unsubmitted Settings draft as the connected host or expose URL credentials/query/path. Read belongs only to the latest user submission and disappears for a newer unacknowledged message; the older-history banner is removed, not pagination. Tool header is only rolling latest actual name/count; individual failures remain specific. Quick effort track33dp, no pending line, rejection above controls; ACK guards and manual dismissal remain. Release0.6.006 and Telegram APK delivery are explicitly authorized; do not infer authorization for future releases or host deployment. Do not deploy or alter the running Pi/Orca/gateway.

Product/version state: README.md (v0.6.006 compact UI/Queue/workflows; current checks and physical-device limits in docs/release-0.6.006.md). Truthful architecture map: docs/architecture.md. Exact current class ownership: architecture/owners.json; feature passports: architecture/capsules/README.md. Visual references: docs/ui-baseline/README.md and immutable PNGs/manifest.json. Wire semantics/security: docs/protocol.md, docs/setup.md; release checks: docs/verification.md.

Android (android/app/src/main/java/ru/billyhargrove/pimobile): PiApp composes the process; MainActivity.kt composes features/catalog/CatalogSession (confirmed scoped commands, lifecycle generations) and CatalogScreen (Compose catalog/direct history and grouped settings), Kotlin/Compose ArchiveSheet and UsageCards. ChatActivity.kt is a Kotlin lifecycle/platform shell for features/chat/ChatSession (injected transport, canonical state, scoped ACK/control/history/config, epochs/follow-tail), ChatOutbox (receipts, retained drafts and explicit retry/restore) and Compose ChatScreen (header, transcript, attachments/skills/composer/delivery). OrchestrationActivity.kt owns Compose workflow/agent drill-down and consumes ui/PiTranscript without optional command actions. TranscriptPresentation is the shared presentation policy; old chat Java widgets/adapter/XML are removed. EffortSlider.kt is the Compose brain control shared by both bounded model sheets. PiTheme owns the neutral palettes/default content color. All production Android source is Kotlin. Markwon/LaTeX and image zoom remain bounded native leaves; model/effort/dictation/document/update containers render Compose in owned platform modal hosts. Legacy screen XML/adapters are removed. Integrated Node/JVM/build and all synthetic UI scenarios have passing coverage, including focused fixes, display/motion checks and actual read-only relay. In-place upgrade/rollback retains encrypted settings/outbox; physical-device acceptance remains open. core/net/store/media retain existing contracts and private data. Read current tests/owners/passports before editing; no permanent dual implementations. Billy's six ChatGPT screenshots and effort-slider video are the original design direction (goal/slice004); 0.6.005 explicitly removes the left drawer and all lower Toast/Snackbar notifications. Effort/model/tier selections and ACK do not auto-dismiss their panels. Keep composer IME options stable through keyboard dismissal; read receipts are quiet captions outside bubbles. The immutable UI baseline remains a behavior/before reference.

Ownership guard: owners.json declares file-level publicFeatureApis, compositionRoots and bounded platformInteropDependencies. Shared ui/ does not expose every feature implementation; wildcard/aliased imports and secondary Kotlin exports are checked too. See loop-develop/slices/006-final-acceptance-audit.md for final evidence and open device/session checks.

Host: server/gateway.mjs is composition root for HTTP/WS/Unix bridge; server/command-policy.mjs validates bounded commands, server/message-projection.mjs sanitizes transcript rows, server/media-cache.mjs bounds image bytes, server/session-projection.mjs sanitizes public configuration and snapshot frames; server/orchestration.mjs owns bounded read-only workflow/agent storage; extension/mobile.ts interfaces with Pi; contracts/agent-transcript.mjs contains pure transcript projection shared between server and extension. Neither runtime imports the other's implementation. Do not alter live gateway or Pi processes for validation.

Gates: npm run quality (Node tests, ownership/import boundaries, screenshot hashes), then android/gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest with JDK17 and API35 SDK. ADB Android UI tests do not dispatch prompts. Run final checks after the rewrite, then focused checks for concrete failures. Release0.6.006 and APK delivery to Parilka228 are explicitly requested; preserve the certificate and verify actual GitHub APK/digest and correct Telegram destination. Physical-device acceptance is still required for the full goal. Architecture guards must grow with ownership changes, not be bypassed.
